verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Google Cloud ships a first-party AI platform (Vertex AI, pitched as a 'full-stack foundation' for agentic systems) and first-party 'AI APIs' reachable through its documented REST and client-library APIs. Nothing describes managed model inference itself or which models are served. missing for 10: explicit documentation of managed inference/model serving, evidence of frontier-model access, evidence of open-model hosting, model API reference docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native team, models are a platform service — first-party managed inference over frontier and open models with a documented API

citations.quote: It provides the full-stack foundation and extensive developer choice you need to transform your applications and workflows into powerful agentic systems at global scale.
Get free usage of AI APIs, Compute Engine, BigQuery, and other popular products up to monthly limits
Use these Cloud APIs with REST calls or client libraries in popular programming languages.
